questions.q: Which city surrounds Vatican City?
questions.why: It is an enclave inside Rome.

questions.q: What is Vatican City famous for being?
questions.why: It covers about 0.44 square kilometres.

questions.q: Who is the head of state of Vatican City?
questions.why: He is also Bishop of Rome.

questions.q: Which 1929 treaty created Vatican City as a state?
questions.why: Mussolini's government signed it.

questions.q: Which Swiss soldiers guard the Pope?
questions.why: They have served since 1506.

questions.q: Which pope was elected in May 2025?
questions.why: He was born in Chicago.

questions.q: What rises from the chimney when a new pope is chosen?
questions.why: Black smoke means no decision yet.

questions.q: What is the gathering of cardinals that elects a pope called?
questions.why: It is held in the Sistine Chapel.

questions.q: Which Polish pope led the Church from 1978 to 2005?
questions.why: He was made a saint in 2014.

questions.q: Which pope resigned in 2013?
questions.why: It was the first resignation in about 600 years.

questions.q: What were the lands the popes ruled until 1870 called?
questions.why: Italian troops took Rome in 1870.

questions.q: Which Argentine pope served from 2013 to 2025?
questions.why: He was the first pope from the Americas.

questions.q: Which pope began building the new St Peter's Basilica in 1506?
questions.why: He also hired Michelangelo for the Sistine ceiling.

questions.q: Which council of 1962–65 modernised the Catholic Church?
questions.why: It allowed Mass in local languages.

questions.q: What is the Vatican's central government office called?
questions.why: It helps the Pope run the Church.

questions.q: Which artist painted the Sistine Chapel ceiling?
questions.why: He worked on it from 1508 to 1512.

questions.q: Which huge church stands over the tomb of St Peter?
questions.why: It is one of the largest churches in the world.

questions.q: What is the official language of Vatican City's state?
questions.why: Latin is the language of the Holy See.

questions.q: Which square in front of St Peter's has a colonnade by Bernini?
questions.why: It can hold tens of thousands of people.

questions.q: Which fresco shows God giving life to Adam?
questions.why: It is on the Sistine Chapel ceiling.

questions.q: What is the Vatican's currency?
questions.why: It issues its own euro coins.

questions.q: Which radio station broadcasts from the Vatican?
questions.why: Guglielmo Marconi helped set it up in 1931.

questions.q: Which Raphael fresco in the Vatican shows Greek philosophers?
questions.why: Plato and Aristotle stand at its centre.

questions.q: Which Michelangelo statue of Mary holding Jesus is in St Peter's?
questions.why: It is the only work he signed.

questions.q: Which Vatican museum is one of the most visited in the world?
questions.why: It has about 7 km of halls.

questions.q: What colour are the Swiss Guards' famous uniforms?
questions.why: The design is often credited to Michelangelo.

questions.q: Which ancient Egyptian monument stands in St Peter's Square?
questions.why: It was moved there in 1586.

questions.q: Which secret passage links the Vatican to Castel Sant'Angelo?
questions.why: Popes fled through it during the 1527 sack of Rome.

questions.q: What is the Vatican's library called?
questions.why: It was founded in 1475.

questions.q: Which Bernini canopy stands over the altar in St Peter's?
questions.why: It is made of bronze.
